content.title: The secondary market's capitalization conundrum
content.summary: Twice a year, some of the largest intermediaries in the secondary market publish data, based on a survey of buyers, outlining the volume of trade in fund stakes. That 2025 was a record year is beyond dispute. On Tuesday, secondary market intermediaries Jefferies, PJT Partners and Campbell Lutyens all published data putting total transaction volumes for 2025 at between $225 billion and $240 billion.
